description:
Ship Gallery

Spoiler

Hall of Triumph 2.0

Turn all those rare, unique, and questionably acquired ships gathering dust in storage into a monument to your accomplishments—and make them generate story points while they are at it.

For Starsector 0.98a | Source Code and Issue Tracker

Updating from 1.0.x? Delete the old Hall of Triumph folder before installing 2.0. Do not overwrite the previous installation.

What Does This Do?

Adds the Hall of Triumph, a unique ship-storage structure for your colonies. Ships placed on display remain stored normally while contributing to passive story-point generation across your entire Hall of Triumph network.

Adds Isa Leicester, a salvager, ship-modder, recruitable officer, and terrible influence overall. Display enough ships from different factions and doctrines to unlock unique 0-OP trophy hullmods through her showcase programs.

Version 2.0 also adds Isa's complete story quest, A Borrowed Name, leading through the Shattered Ring, both Coronal Hypershunts, experimental Mk IV fleets, and the sealed prototype Dyson sphere of Gan Eden.

What Is in This Mod?

New colony structure: Hall of Triumph
New NPC contact and officer: Isa Leicester
New story quest: A Borrowed Name
New location: The Shattered Ring, an Independent free port in Penelope's Star
New hidden system: Gan Eden, a prototype Dyson sphere containing four colonizable settlement sites
Vanilla trophy hullmods: Legacy, Zeal, Pageantry, Optimization, Humanity, Memory, Awe, Gaze, and Contempt
Cross-mod trophy hullmods: Honor, Resonance, Discipline, Inheritance, and Vow
Experimental Mk IV ships: Pirate and Luddic Path refit programs with custom variants and faction-specific artwork
New encounters: Hypershunt blockades, the Ivory Custodians, COMSEC REDACTED, and escalating rematches
Additional content: Custom illustrations, combat environments, music, faction vignettes, Gan Eden Archives, and a unique D-mod service at the Shattered Ring
Cross-mod content integration:
Black Lion Ships
Knights Hospitaller
United Aurora Federation
Knights of Ludd
Iron Shell
Combat Chatter

But Why?

I was playing Starsector and realized I had all these cool unique ships, but because I was roleplaying a particular fleet flavor or whatever, I had no use for them. So I chucked them into storage and imagined it as a kind of trophy room.

Then it hit me: why not actually reward the player for hoarding like this? Anyhow, there goes another weekend.

FAQ

Is it mid-save compatible?

Yes. Hall of Triumph, Isa, and the Shattered Ring are designed to initialize when an existing campaign is loaded. As always with a major mod update, keeping a backup save is recommended.

Does it require a new game?

No. If Penelope's Star exists in your sector, the Shattered Ring will be generated the next time the campaign is loaded. Random-sector setups without Penelope's Star safely skip its generation.

Does it require any other mods?

No. All integrations are optional and are only activated when their corresponding mods are installed.

How do I meet Isa?

Build a functional Hall of Triumph, then look for her in a dockside bar event.

Known incompatibilities?

Second-in-Command may make Humanity less useful because of the way it changes or removes Neural Link behavior. I have not found any hard startup incompatibilities, but please report anything strange on GitHub or in this thread.

Just like.... all of AotD, probably. Old version of AotD may work but I've been getting a lot of reports of crashes, quest locks and freezing with newer versions so for now I'll just outright state that AotD should be considered as highly unstable with this mod.

If yer really scared, avoid IndEvo or Terraforming or anything else that touches the planets in general

Does it work in randomized sectors?

The Hall of Triumph and Isa's showcase programs do. However, A Borrowed Name currently requires the vanilla Penelope's Star system and cannot begin in randomized sectors that omit it.

Hints and Progression Spoilers

Spoiler
Ships must be placed inside a Hall of Triumph's dedicated storage tab to count toward network generation and Isa's showcase programs.

Most doctrine hullmods require 40 unique deployment points from that faction or subtype. Domain Derelict/Explorarium ships require 20 unique deployment points.

The vanilla doctrine programs cover XIV Battlegroup, Luddic Path, Lion's Guard, Tri-Tachyon/high-tech, Remnant, and Domain Derelict ships.

To complete Awe, display an Onslaught XIV, Paragon, Invictus, Conquest, and Executor.

Display the Ziggurat and an Onslaught Mk.I to complete two unique-ship trophy programs.

Spoiler
Complete every vanilla doctrine and vanilla unique-ship program to recruit Isa as a level-8 officer with two exclusive skills.

After recruiting Isa, bring her to the Shattered Ring in Penelope's Star to begin A Borrowed Name.

Spoiler
The quest eventually requires investigating both surviving Coronal Hypershunts. Compare what you recover from them carefully, and make sure you have Transverse Jump.

AI Statement

OpenAI Codex 5.6 Sol was used to help with programming, debugging, and editing. Artwork was created through a combination of Photoshop and Gemini. Don't worry, I'm a professional.

Music Credits

Lonesome Journey
Composer: Keys of Moon
Composer's channel
Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0.

Strike from the Sky
Composer: Ucchii0
Official source and terms
The purchased loop-ready edition is used.

Kono Saki wa, Kimi dake de. (Beyond This Point, Only You)
Composer: Ucchii0

Changelog

2.5.1 hotfix
Fixed some rules.csv options in Isa's unfinished masterwork dialogue option\
Fixed a portrait draw issue when exiting out of that malformed dialogue state
Set the Ship Gallery option to an optional Lunalib setting, defaulted to False.

2.5 hotfix

Pushed another fix addressing Ivory Ordo freezing issues.
Added Console Commands that force update the quest state if you are playing with a mod like AotD that overwrites Hypershunt interaction as this will softlock you out of the quest.

OpenGanEdenHypershunt [1|2]
AdvanceGanEdenHypershunts
AdvanceGanEdenHypershunts all

Hotfix — August 9, 2026
Corrected Gan Eden transit and Personal Log dialogue.
Removed the Transverse Jump reference from the Power Transit Gate description.
Increased the Cherubim and Lahat Haharev reconstruction interval from 90 days to one campaign year.
Added a reconstruction countdown to the Space Elevator interaction.
This is a save-compatible asset update. The release URL and download filenames are unchanged.

8/8/2026 — Version 2.0.0
Added the complete A Borrowed Name quest through the Coronal Hypershunts, Power Transit Gate, Gan Eden, Tree of Life, Golden Omega confrontation, and Space Elevator finale.
Added the Shattered Ring free port, Isa's homecoming, Gan Eden Archives, and the Isaac/Ludd afterstory.
Added four colonizable Gan Eden settlement sites and the Heavens Scar boundary region.
Added Pirate and Luddic Path Mk IV refit programs, authored variants, custom paint treatments, and post-battle fleet propagation.
Added Pageantry and Optimization to the vanilla doctrine rewards.
Added or expanded integrations for Knights of Ludd, UAF, Iron Shell, Black Lion Ships, Knights Hospitaller, and Combat Chatter.
Added custom art for the Hall of Triumph hullmods, Mk IV ships, ivory Remnants, locations, and encounters.
Set most doctrine unlocks to 40 unique DP and Domain Derelict/Explorarium unlocks to 20 unique DP.
Added escalating COMSEC REDACTED rematches and a chance for ordinary Remnant Ordos to field COMSEC REDACTED escorts after the first victory.
Improved save migration, encounter persistence, battle cleanup, quest recovery, Transverse Jump arrivals, and final-log music cleanup.

7/21/2026: Updated Awe's description to clarify that it only affects supported positive S-mod bonuses.
7/21/2026: Released the code under the MIT License.
GitHub repository
If you fork or build on the repository, please let me know. I would be genuinely interested in seeing what you make.

Possible Future Work

Additional cross-mod trophy programs and post-recruitment faction vignettes.
Simplified and Traditional Chinese localization.
Further balance, compatibility, and presentation improvements based on player feedback.
